scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,stencil -c auto --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:client" "bun run stencil"
scripts.dev:docker: bun run dev:docker:build && concurrently -n info,stack -c magenta,blue --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:docker:info" "bun run dev:docker:up"
scripts.dev:docker:up: sh -c 'cleanup() { docker compose down; }; trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT; docker compose up -d && bun run dev:docker:logs; rc=$?; trap - INT TERM EXIT; cleanup; exit $rc'
scripts.dev:docker:db:init: docker compose exec api bun run db:migrate && docker compose exec api bun run db:seed
scripts.dev:docker:info:
bun -e "console.log('Trust Center Docker dev ready
  UI:      http://localhost:5173/trust-center/
  API:     http://localhost:4000/graphql
  Health:  http://localhost:4000/api/health
  DB:      local postgres container by default
  Notes:   use bun run dev:docker:db:init after the stack is up to migrate and seed
')"
scripts.dev:docker:remote: sh -c 'test -n "$DOCKER_REMOTE_DATABASE_URL" || { printf "DOCKER_REMOTE_DATABASE_URL is required\n" >&2; exit 1; }; bun run dev:docker:build && concurrently -n info,stack -c magenta,blue --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:docker:info:remote" "bun run dev:docker:up:remote"'
scripts.dev:docker:up:remote: sh -c 'cleanup() { docker compose down; }; trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT; docker compose up -d && bun run dev:docker:logs; rc=$?; trap - INT TERM EXIT; cleanup; exit $rc'
scripts.dev:docker:info:remote:
bun -e "console.log('Trust Center Docker remote-db dev ready
  UI:      http://localhost:5173/trust-center/
  API:     http://localhost:4000/graphql
  Health:  http://localhost:4000/api/health
  DB:      remote database override via DOCKER_REMOTE_DATABASE_URL
  Notes:   local postgres still starts, but the API uses the remote database when the override is set
')"
scripts.build: bun run build:stencil && bun run build:client
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:e2e:headed
scripts.cleanexit: concurrently -n server,client,stencil,fail -c auto --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:client" "bun run stencil" "node -e \"console.error('[fail] waiting 12s then exiting 1'); setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 12000)\""
